The ordinary suite and typecheck pass, but current-HEAD production-seam review found one truthful Navigator ordering counterexample and an executable identical-call overlap that launches duplicate children. classes.name: NavigatorEvidenceReadTruthResidual
classes.owner: Navigator evidence store -> native session -> Recorder sealing/readSealed -> Runner receipt-validation seam
classes.boundary: The authoritative typed read record must preserve partial and complete byte coverage independent of read order, in both live and recovered Recorder settlements, without manufacturing fullyRead values.
classes.disposition: OPEN. `NavigatorEvidenceStore.readRecord()` emits records in snapshot/catalog order, while `sealedEvidenceReads()` emits Map insertion order (native tool-call order), and `validateNavigatorReceiptV1()` compares arrays order-exactly. A valid Navigator that reads evidence B before A therefore passes in-seat validation but is rejected after Recorder sealing even though both records are truthful. The new test invokes only `sealedEvidenceReads` on handcrafted JSONL; the Runner test mocks `invokeNavigator`, and no test traverses Recorder live sealing or `readSealed`. Normalize the same authoritative record at the owning seam and add executable live plus recovery coverage for out-of-catalog read order, partial=false, paged-complete=true, and forged/omitted/duplicate/unknown/unread rejection.

classes.name: LedgerLoserRereadResidual
classes.owner: Assisted Runner call replay and append-only lifecycle transition seam
classes.boundary: A compatible same-call replay must return canonical completed truth, or fail closed while the winning lifecycle is pending, before any Navigator or selected role launch; incompatible/corrupt ledger truth remains fatal.
classes.disposition: OPEN. Reconciliation occurs only after an append conflict and only recognizes an exact event payload. A same-call caller that observes the existing `call_started` row can continue with stale local rows; delayed acquisition is then appended after the winner has completed, and the replay launches a second Navigator and selected role. An executable current-HEAD barrier probe produced `{same:false,navs:4,roles:2}` for two identical calls, versus the required one lifecycle (`navs:2, roles:1`) and canonical result. The committed replay test is sequential after completion, not the required overlapping replay; there is still no deterministic concurrent recovery barrier. Reconcile/fence from canonical lifecycle state immediately before every launch-bearing transition, and prove delayed identical enter/resume and concurrent recovery cases, pending-winner fail-closed behavior, canonical completed result/status, one recovery fact, one Navigator lifecycle per required consultation, at most one selected role, and fatal incompatible/hash-corrupt truth.
